mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix fact body lets the model assign arbitrary permissions to roles, violating the least-privilege and role-based access control invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadPermissions { some r: Role | some ok: OperationKind | (r -> ok) in PermMatrix.allowed and not ((r in (DoctorRole + NurseRole + PharmacistRole + ClinicalAdminRole) and ok in (ReadRecord + AddNote)) or (r = HospitalAdministratorRole and ok = ListAudit)) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows notes to exist without matching audit entries, violating the one-to-one correspondence and always-on audit invariants.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some n: ClinicalNote | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.noteId = n.noteId and ae.accessType = AddNote and ae.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits notes to be deleted or mutated, violating append-only semantics.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NotesDeletable { some n: ClinicalNote | n not in ClinicalNote }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries to have mismatched user display names or roles, violating attribution correctness.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_BadAttribution { some ae: AuditEntry | some u: User | u.userId = ae.userId and (u.displayName != ae.displayName or u.userRole != ae.userRole) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Denied and NotFoundOrDenied outcomes to differ structurally, leaking information about whether a resource exists.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InfoLeakage { some ae: AuditEntry | (ae.outcome = Denied or ae.outcome = NotFoundOrDenied) and ae.accessType != ReadRecord and ae.accessType != AddNote }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows audit entries with no matching authenticated user, violating the authentication-required invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Unauthenticated { some ae: AuditEntry | no u: User | u.userId = ae.userId }
